title: FY27 Euclid Creek Fishway Construction
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > LRD > W072 ENDIST BUFFALO
description:
Amendment 00001: Amendment 00001 includes information on a site visit to be conducted on November 13, 2026 at 12:00 pm EST. The address for this site visit is:  1201 E 185th St, Cleveland, OH 44119.    Additionally, this amendment includes changes to the plans and specs to no longer include tree felling as part of the project requirements. The contractor will still be required to remove the felled trees from the work site. Please acknowledge this amendment in the submission of your bids.  

 This posting is an Invitation for Bid (IFB) issued by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Buffalo District, for the construction of the Euclid Creek Fishway at the existing Euclid Creek Spillway in Cleveland, Cuyahoga County, Ohio. The project includes construction of a fishway within the existing spillway and modification of the spillway as necessary to accommodate the fishway. Additional work includes construction of an access road, retaining wall, railing, and road gate; tieback design and tieback fabrication/installation for the retaining wall; and site restoration in accordance with the plans and specifications. Associated work includes concrete removal, excavation, dewatering, clearing and grubbing, and other incidental work necessary to provide a complete and usable project. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. This acquisition will be competed as a 100% Small Business Set-Aside. The magnitude of construction is estimated to be between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000.Please be advised that this requirement is subject to change and may be revised or canceled at any time prior to award.
